subtitles.en: Laurie, it really just feels that in this world of private capital giants, the bigger just continue, the big continue to just get bigger.

subtitles.en: That's right. Yeah, this week was proof of that. So we saw a polar report record fees from management fees and a lot of that came from their capital solutions business, which is where they
subtitles.zh: 没错，本周就是证明。Apollo报告管理费收入创纪录，主要来自资本解决方案业务。

subtitles.en: originate loans. And that's where we've seen this, you know, some of the really big investment grade jumbo loans being originated in the last year or so, particularly even this year.
subtitles.zh: 该业务涉及贷款发起，过去一年左右，特别是今年，我们看到一些大型**级巨额贷款。

subtitles.en: There was a big board company, which was that, if I believe, that color led to that came from the capital solutions business, that the revenue from that and those fees are definitely driving
subtitles.zh: 有一家大型董事会公司，其收入来自资本解决方案业务，这些费用正推动基金增长。

subtitles.en: growth at the fund. And it's a cool part of that business right now. I mean, it's interesting to look at all the different giants and different businesses that are doing well. I spoke with both
subtitles.zh: 这是该业务中很酷的部分。看看不同巨头和业务的表现很有趣。我今天早上与凯雷和布鲁克菲尔德交谈。

subtitles.en: Carlisle and Brookfield this morning, for example, both them reporting earnings saying, look at the huge amount of fundraising we're doing. KKR also raising their biggest ever infrastructure
subtitles.zh: 两家公司都报告了大规模募资。KKR也在募集其史上最大基础设施基金。
zh_highlights: 史上最大基础设施基金

subtitles.en: fund. Laura, is there something to this? And I wonder just how much of the excitement is around AI strategies? And that's why these funds are able to raise so much money.
subtitles.zh: Laura，这是否与AI策略有关？这些基金能募集这么多资金，是否因为AI热潮？

subtitles.en: Absolutely. It's still very active. It's very real right now, which is something KKR said this week.
subtitles.zh: 当然，现在依然非常活跃，非常真实，KKR本周也这么说。

subtitles.en: My colleague, Alison McLeely, reported on this, this huge fund rose earlier this week. And it's so interesting because for all the worries and concerns that we're hearing and that are also very
subtitles.zh: 我的同事Alison McLeely报道了本周早些时候这只大型基金的募集。有趣的是，尽管存在各种担忧，

subtitles.en: real, you know, managers are able to go out and make these big deals and, you know, raise huge amounts of capital for it. So I think while investors are digesting and asking questions,
subtitles.zh: 但管理人仍能达成大交易并募集大量资金。我认为市场参与者在消化和提问的同时，

subtitles.en: they're still willing to allocate. And I think, you know, I think the key is diversity as well.
subtitles.zh: 他们仍愿意配置，而且我认为关键在于多元化。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗

具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
